name: Tabletop Security Exercise
description: Scenario-based security drill template for testing incident response, roles, communication, and decision-making.

sections.title: Exercise Scenario
sections.instruction: Summarize the simulated threat, starting conditions, assumptions, and exercise scope

sections.title: Participants & Roles
sections.instruction: List participants, response roles, observers, facilitators, and decision authorities

sections.title: Injects & Responses
sections.instruction: Capture scenario updates, team responses, decisions made, and rationale

sections.title: Control Gaps Found
sections.instruction: List gaps in detection, access control, procedures, tooling, communication, or ownership

sections.title: Decision Points
sections.instruction: Summarize major decisions, escalation thresholds, legal or compliance considerations, and unresolved debates

sections.title: Lessons Learned
sections.instruction: Capture what worked, what slowed response, and where roles or playbooks need clarification

sections.title: Remediation Backlog
sections.instruction: List corrective actions, owners, priorities, due dates, and verification method
